title: Median price across pools
summary: The median price of a token in a quote token across two to four concentrated-liquidity pools of that pair, optionally refusing pools below a liquidity floor.

params.name: chain
params.doc: CAIP-2 id or alias (EVM, Solana chains)

params.name: finality
params.doc: "final" or "fast", or a raw mode: "finalized", "safe", "confirmations:<n>" (EVM, Starknet), "confirmed" (Solana)

params.name: quote
params.doc: the token it is priced in

params.name: pools
params.doc: 2 to 4 Uniswap v3-style pools, or Solana Orca Whirlpool and Raydium CLMM pools (mixed), of exactly this pair

params.name: minLiquidity
params.doc: every pool's active liquidity (raw units) must be at least this, or the round fails; on EVM at most 2 pools then (liquidity is a second read)

returns: quote-token units per one token, 18 decimals (uint256; int256 on Solana, tolerance mode)
caveats: The median is taken over the pools' square-root prices, then squared: for an even count it is the square of the mean of the two middle square roots, a hair below the mean of the two middle prices.
A pool below the floor fails the whole round; nothing is signed without it.
No USD: the price names its quote token.
